label.purpose: Eyebrows, metadata, navigation, and compact actions.

components.name: Primary Booking Button
components.description: The canonical direct-booking action on dark and photographic surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(98.5% 0.001 106.423); color: oklch(14.7% 0.004 49.25); font: 600 12px/1.25 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 300ms, color 300ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(92.3% 0.003 48.717); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(87.9% 0.169 91.605 / 0.55); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Contact Button
components.description: A quieter companion action when direct booking remains primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: oklch(98.5% 0.001 106.423); font: 600 12px/1.25 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 300ms, color 300ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(98.5% 0.001 106.423); color: oklch(14.7% 0.004 49.25); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.45); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Experience Card
components.description: A restrained supporting card for practical or experiential details.
components.html:
✦

Lake and quiet

A calmer base for better sleep and easy lake walks.
components.css: .ds-experience-card { width: 280px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: oklch(98.5% 0.001 106.423); transition: transform 300ms, background-color 300ms, border-color 300ms; } .ds-experience-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-color: oklch(89.7% 0.196 126.665 / 0.4); } .ds-experience-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid oklch(89.7% 0.196 126.665 / 0.4); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-experience-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; margin-bottom: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(89.7% 0.196 126.665 / 0.1); color: oklch(89.7% 0.196 126.665); } .ds-experience-card h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 600 18px/1.25 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-experience-card p { margin: 0; color: oklch(70.9% 0.01 56.259); font: 400 14px/1.625 Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: The public-form field pattern on atmospheric dark surfaces.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-field">DATES</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-field" placeholder="July 12 to 15">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); font: 600 11px/1.25 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.22em; } .ds-field { width: 280px; height: 44px; padding: 4px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: oklch(98.5% 0.001 106.423); font: 400 16px/1.625 Inter, sans-serif; transition: border-color 300ms; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: oklch(55.3% 0.013 58.071); } .ds-field:hover { border-bottom-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: oklch(87.9% 0.169 91.605); outline: none; }

components.name: Glass Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav { height: 80px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); background: oklch(14.7% 0.004 49.25 / 0.8); color: oklch(98.5% 0.001 106.423); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); } .ds-nav-brand { display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin-right: auto; font: 900 30px/0.9 Outfit, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.05em; } .ds-nav-brand small { margin-top: 5px; color: oklch(70.9% 0.01 56.259); font: 500 10px/1 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-nav a { color: oklch(92.3% 0.003 48.717); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 300ms; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: oklch(87.9% 0.169 91.605); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(87.9% 0.169 91.605); outline-offset: 6px; }

components.name: Location Chip
components.description: A compact context marker used over hero photography.
components.html: SAN PEDRO LA LAGUNA
components.css: .ds-location-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); font: 600 10px/1.25 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); transition: background-color 300ms, border-color 300ms; } .ds-location-chip:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.32); } .ds-location-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid white; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-location-chip svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

components.name: Image Panel
components.description: The signature editorial photograph container for property comparisons and galleries.
components.html:
MANDALAS

SOCIAL

For walking, rooftop sunsets, and being close to what is happening.
components.css: .ds-image-panel { position: relative; width: 320px; min-height: 400px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); background: oklch(21.6% 0.006 56.043); color: white; } .ds-image-field { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(145deg, oklch(55.5% 0.163 48.998), oklch(14.7% 0.004 49.25)); transform: scale(1.04); transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1); } .ds-image-panel::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.85), rgba(0,0,0,0.2), rgba(0,0,0,0.05)); } .ds-image-panel:hover .ds-image-field { transform: scale(1.09); } .ds-image-panel:focus-within { outline: 3px solid oklch(87.9% 0.169 91.605 / 0.5); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-image-copy { position: absolute; z-index: 1; left: 24px; right: 24px; bottom: 24px; } .ds-image-copy small { color: oklch(87.9% 0.169 91.605); font: 600 10px/1 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.24em; } .ds-image-copy h3 { margin: 12px 0 16px; font: 300 42px/1 Outfit, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .ds-image-copy p { margin: 0; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.68); font: 400 14px/1.625 Inter, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Mandalas se siente cinematográfico, editorial, auténtico y sereno. La fotografía real ocupa el primer plano; las capas oscuras, la tipografía espaciada y el movimiento lento permiten que dos experiencias distintas se sientan parte de una sola marca.

El sistema contrapone la energía cálida y social de Mandalas con la calma vegetal de Hideout sin convertirlas en marcas separadas. La estructura compartida permanece sobria y nocturna; Golden Rooftop y Lake Moss aparecen como señales escasas que orientan al viajero hacia cada ritmo.
keyCharacteristics: Fotografía inmersiva con encuadres amplios y tratamiento cinematográfico.
Base Atitlán Night con texto claro, bordes translúcidos y capas atmosféricas.
Titulares Outfit ligeros, en mayúsculas y con tracking generoso.
Golden Rooftop identifica Mandalas; Lake Moss identifica Hideout.
Acciones directas y legibles que conducen a elegir y reservar.

rules.name: The Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Golden Rooftop pertenece a Mandalas y Lake Moss pertenece a Hideout; no se mezclan en un mismo control salvo cuando la interfaz compara explícitamente ambas propiedades.

rules.name: The Air Around Type Rule
rules.body: Los titulares espaciados necesitan margen y contraste; no deben apilarse dentro de tarjetas densas ni competir con varias etiquetas de igual peso.

rules.name: The Atmospheric Layers Rule
rules.body: Primero se crea profundidad con imagen, tono, borde y transparencia; una sombra sólo entra cuando existe una separación funcional entre planos.

dos: Do usar fotografía real de Mandalas, Hideout y Lago Atitlán como principal fuente de atmósfera.
Do mantener Golden Rooftop para Mandalas y Lake Moss para Hideout.
Do combinar paneles rectos con acciones pill para conservar contraste formal.
Do mantener suficiente espacio alrededor de titulares uppercase con tracking amplio.
Do usar movimiento lento y contenido: 300ms para estados y 700–1500ms para fotografía.
donts: Don't convertir el sitio en una estética genérica de resort tropical.
Don't llenar las páginas de degradados brillantes o acentos simultáneos.
Don't repetir cuadrículas de tarjetas redondeadas cuando una composición editorial o una lista abierta comunica mejor.
Don't trasladar el estilo denso del panel administrativo al sitio público.
Don't usar sombras fuertes en todas las superficies ni sustituir fotografías reales por ilustraciones turísticas genéricas.
